# Godzilla Docs

> Everything you need to build data pipelines on the Godzilla platform.

## Pages
- [Changelog](https://localhost:4310/changelog): Recent changes to the Godzilla API and platform.
- [Glossary (Archived)](https://localhost:4310/glossary): Definitions for Godzilla's core terms, each linking to its full explanation.
- [Godzilla Docs](https://localhost:4310/index): Everything you need to build data pipelines on the Godzilla platform.
- [Security & compliance overview](https://localhost:4310/security-and-compliance): How Godzilla handles data in transit and at rest, credential storage, and compliance posture.
- [Support / Contact](https://localhost:4310/support): How to reach the Godzilla team for support, sales, or security reports.
- [Troubleshooting / FAQ](https://localhost:4310/troubleshooting): Common problems and fixes across pipelines, connectors, and webhooks.

## api
- [API Reference](https://localhost:4310/api/index): The Godzilla v2 REST API: pipelines, connectors, events, webhooks, limits, quotas, and errors.
- [API Reference](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/index): The Godzilla v3 REST API: pipelines, connectors, events, webhooks, limits, quotas, and errors.
- [API Reference](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/index): The Godzilla v2 REST API: pipelines, connectors, events, webhooks, limits, quotas, and errors. (Legacy - use v3 for new integrations)
- [Connectors endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/connectors): Create, list, and rotate credentials for connectors via the v3 REST API.
- [Connectors endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/connectors): Create, list, and rotate credentials for connectors via the v2 REST API.
- [Error reference](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/error-reference): Error response codes and details for the v3 API.
- [Error reference](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/error-reference): Error response shape and details for the v2 API.
- [Events endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/events): Query and replay events that have flowed through a pipeline via the v3 REST API.
- [Events endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/events): Query and replay events that have flowed through a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
- [Limits, quotas & errors](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/rate-limits-errors): Standard-tier limits, quotas, pagination envelope, and the v2 API's error response shape.
- [Limits, quotas & errors](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/rate-limits-errors): Standard-tier limits, quotas, pagination envelope, and the v3 API's error response shape.
- [Pipelines endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/pipelines): Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v3 REST API with improved error handling and pagination.
- [Pipelines endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/pipelines): Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v2 REST API.
- [Quotas & billing](https://localhost:4310/api/quotas-billing): Plan tiers, quotas, and what happens when your account exceeds limits.
- [Rate limits](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/rate-limits): Standard-tier rate limits, quotas, and pagination for the v3 API.
- [Rate limits](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/rate-limits): Standard-tier rate limits, quotas, and pagination envelope for the v2 API.
- [Transforms endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/transforms): Create and list transform steps that reshape, filter, and enrich events as they flow through a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
- [Transforms endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/transforms): Create and list transform steps that reshape, filter, and enrich events as they flow through a pipeline via the v3 REST API.
- [Webhooks endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v3/webhooks): Subscribe to Godzilla platform lifecycle events over outbound HTTP via the v3 REST API.
- [Webhooks endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/v2/webhooks): Subscribe to Godzilla platform lifecycle events over outbound HTTP via the v2 REST API.

## concepts
- [Concepts](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts): The three core building blocks of Godzilla: pipelines, connectors, and events.
- [Connectors](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-connectors): What a connector is in Godzilla: a pre-built integration to a source or destination system, with its own auth and catalog of built-in types.
- [Events](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-events): What an event is in Godzilla: the atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, plus the platform's own lifecycle events.
- [Pipelines](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-pipelines): What a pipeline is in Godzilla: a named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector through transform steps to a destination.
- [Schemas](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-schemas): How event payload shapes are declared, validated, and evolved in Godzilla pipelines.

## getting-started
- [Authentication](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/getting-started-authentication): Authenticate API requests with a bearer API key.
- [Getting Started](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/index): Get up and running with Godzilla in three steps.
- [Installation](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/getting-started-installation): Install the Godzilla SDK or start calling the REST API directly.
- [Quickstart](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/getting-started-quickstart): Go from zero to a running pipeline in five minutes.

## guides
- [Building your first pipeline](https://localhost:4310/guides/building-your-first-pipeline): Create a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that connects them, end to end.
- [Connecting a data source](https://localhost:4310/guides/connecting-a-data-source): Choose the right connector type and authentication method for a new data source.
- [Error handling & recovery](https://localhost:4310/guides/handling-errors-and-retries): How Godzilla retries failed events, when they're dead-lettered, and how to replay them.
- [Guides](https://localhost:4310/guides/index): Task-oriented walkthroughs for building, connecting, and operating Godzilla pipelines.
- [Monitoring & alerts](https://localhost:4310/guides/monitoring-and-alerts): Watch pipeline health and get notified of failures via webhooks before they become incidents.
- [Scheduling & triggers](https://localhost:4310/guides/scheduling-and-triggers): Run a pipeline on a cron schedule or trigger it directly from incoming events.
- [Transforming events in flight](https://localhost:4310/guides/transforming-events-in-flight): Reshape, filter, and enrich events as they pass through a pipeline to match your downstream requirements.

## recipes
- [Backfill historical data](https://localhost:4310/recipes/backfill-historical-data): Replay historical events through a pipeline to populate new destinations or catch up on missed data.
- [Fan-out to multiple destinations](https://localhost:4310/recipes/fan-out-to-multiple-destinations): Route events from a single source to multiple destination connectors in parallel.
- [Recipes](https://localhost:4310/recipes/index): Common patterns and solutions for accomplishing specific tasks with Godzilla pipelines.

## sdks
- [Go SDK](https://localhost:4310/sdks/go): Install and use the godzilla-go SDK to manage pipelines and connectors from Go.
- [Node.js SDK](https://localhost:4310/sdks/node-js): Install and use @godzilla/sdk to manage pipelines and connectors from Node.js.
- [Python SDK](https://localhost:4310/sdks/python): Install and use godzilla-sdk to manage pipelines and connectors from Python.
- [SDKs](https://localhost:4310/sdks/index): Official Godzilla client libraries for Node.js and Python.

## versions
- [Migration guide (v1 → v2)](https://localhost:4310/versions/migration-guide-v1-to-v2): Move an existing v1 integration to the v2 API: cursor pagination, webhooks, and the new error shape.
- [Release notes archive](https://localhost:4310/versions/release-notes-archive): Older v1-era release notes, superseded by the current changelog.
